summary.key_distinction: ACTIVE means current pricing was source-validated and promoted. DAILY_READY additionally requires a canonical source collector/parser, homogeneous current/T-1/T-5 handling, candidate build, fail-closed validation, deterministic runtime apply and promotion path available from main without relying on dated one-shot validation branches.

AUD.source: ASX 30 Day Interbank Cash Rate futures (IB)
AUD.blocker: Activation/probe logic exists in historical validation branches, but no canonical reusable daily collector/parser/apply pipeline is present on main.
AUD.next_required: Promote a source-specific ASX IB collector/parser into a clean refresh module; parameterize trade date and horizon mapping; reuse source-registry and live-update preflight before any runtime mutation.

CAD.blocker: Official Market Review observations were validated and promoted, but the production branch does not yet contain a canonical reusable daily CRA collector/parser/apply pipeline.
CAD.next_required: Build a current-date Market Review resolver plus contract parser with direct quarterly buckets and fail closed when current/T-1/T-5 homogeneous observations are incomplete.

GBP.source: Bank of England estimated sterling OIS forward curve
GBP.blocker: The official BoE workbook extraction was successfully certified for activation, but the extractor/candidate workflow remains validation-branch based rather than a canonical parameterized refresh module on main.
GBP.next_required: Promote a clean BoE OIS archive extractor that resolves latest official business day and homogeneous T-1/T-5 observations, emits CB_PRICING_CANDIDATE_V1, and performs no runtime writes.

JPY.source: Tokyo Financial Exchange Three-month TONA Futures
JPY.evidence: validation/build_jpy_tona_ois_candidate.py on the validation branch is fail-closed and JPY-scoped, but it references a dated candidate file and contains dated/static market-pricing text/values in the native-CB update path.
JPY.blocker: Builder is suitable for one-shot promotion verification, not a generic daily collector/updater.
JPY.next_required: Separate source collection from candidate-to-runtime application; parameterize dates/contracts/values; remove hard-coded pricing strings; retain JPY-only semantic scope checks.

implementation_order_rationale: GBP has a stable official downloadable daily archive and exact tenor columns; JPY already has a strong fail-closed builder pattern; CAD and AUD are next once their source discovery/history retrieval is converted from activation-time probes into reusable daily collectors.
promotion_rule: Do not mark any ACTIVE currency DAILY_READY until a clean main-based dry run can produce a candidate from fresh official data, pass source registry and negative fail-closed checks, rebuild runtime deterministically, and demonstrate currency-only semantic delta without publishing automatically.
